name: tail-log-path-mode-failure-stderr
title: tail_log: emit remote_stderr to stderr on path-mode failure
description: When tail_log path mode fails on the remote side (e.g. file not found), the script exits 1 with empty stdout and empty stderr; the actual reason lives only in --json's remote_stderr field. Pipe remote_stderr first line to local stderr on failure so users get an immediate clue without re-running with --json. Reference Finding #2 in validation-report.md of parent task.
creator: jason
